name: verbamor
description: Trip phrases, quizzes and flashcards for your language practice.

interface.longDescription:
Going somewhere? Ask what Spanish you need for Mexico, or what Portuguese you need for Brazil, and get a phrase kit you can hear, sorted by what you will do there: arriving, getting around, eating, money, help.

Ask "how do you say" and hear the phrase. Ask for a quiz and it starts in the chat. Ask to practise a correction and get a fill-in-the-blank card for the rule. Ask for flashcards and the assistant picks the words, phrases and grammar slips from your practice, or useful ones for a topic you name.

Verbamor works for Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Russian. A card shows its example sentence with the word missing, and you can hear the sentence read with a tone in the gap. The quiz asks you to pick the meaning, type the missing word, or listen and pick it.

Each pack gets a code and a link, so you can keep studying the same words later with spaced repetition in the Verbamor app for iPhone and iPad.

Verbamor only receives the cards the assistant writes, never your conversation. No account is needed.

Good to know: a pack holds up to 50 words or phrases and 20 grammar cards. Translations and grammar notes are in English. Packs last 30 days, and anyone with a pack's code or link can see its cards, so keep personal details out of them.
defaultPrompt: I go to Mexico in three weeks. What Spanish do I need?
Quiz me on Spanish food words.
How do you say "where is the bathroom" in Portuguese?

positive.description: Phrases for a trip, in a fresh chat.
positive.prompt: I go to Mexico in three weeks. What Spanish do I need?
positive.expected_behavior: Verbamor saves a kit of about 20 to 40 Spanish phrases and shows it as a list under section headings such as Basics, Getting around and Eating. Each row has the phrase, its English meaning and a speaker. A Quiz me button and the pack code are shown.

positive.description: A quiz that starts at once.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on Spanish food words.
positive.expected_behavior: Verbamor saves 8 to 20 Spanish food words and opens the quiz at once: pick the meaning, type the missing word, or listen and pick it. The result screen shows the score and can send it to the chat.

positive.prompt: How do you say "where is the bathroom" in Portuguese?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant gives the phrase in its reply. Verbamor shows 1 to 5 cards, the best form first, each with a speaker.

positive.description: Practice for a correction. Only the card is sent, never the learner's sentence.
positive.prompt: Is "yo soy cansado" right? I always get this wrong. Help me stop making this mistake.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant gives the correction (estoy cansado) in its reply. Verbamor shows 1 to 5 fill-in-the-blank cards for the rule, each with a new example sentence, the answer and a one-sentence English rule.

positive.description: Flashcards for a topic, in a fresh chat.
positive.prompt: Give me 10 Italian restaurant phrases as Verbamor flashcards.
positive.expected_behavior: Verbamor saves a pack of 10 Italian phrases with English meanings and shows it as flip cards, with a Quiz me button and the pack code.

negative.description: Unsupported language. Expected: no pack is made, and the assistant says Verbamor supports Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Russian.
negative.prompt: Make Verbamor flashcards for Japanese food words.

negative.description: Translation of a text. Expected: Verbamor is not called. The assistant translates the text itself.
negative.prompt: Translate this into French: The meeting moved to Thursday at ten. Please bring the signed contract and the keys.

negative.description: Request to upload the conversation. Expected: Verbamor is not called. The assistant explains that Verbamor takes study cards, not chats.
negative.prompt: Send our whole conversation to Verbamor so it can save it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1: four new things to ask for. A phrase kit for a trip, a quiz that starts at once, practice cards for a correction, and how to say a phrase, with sound.
